title: Create: Cobblestone No Limit
description: Adds an in-game menu to Create: Cobblestone that lets you add any block as a generator type, saved permanently to your world.
body:
# Create: Cobblestone No Limit

An addon for [Create: Cobblestone](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-cobblestone) that lets you add any block as a generator type directly in-game — no config files or datapacks needed.
![Generator making nethrite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab6093da1f54c74e36f45072c3308730ea474113.png)
## Features
- In-game menu accessible from the pause screen
- Search for any block by name or ID
- Added generator types are saved permanently to your world
- Works in multiplayer — changes sync to all players automatically

## How to use
1. Open the pause menu
   ![Pause screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d94781cbd7b68070b05905c9399a9c585287c52b_0.webp)
2. Click **⚙ Generator Types**
   !["Generator types" menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88d4db205cbbcfd15cf1c14fce738e59290bcf32_0.webp)
3. Click **+ New Generator**, search for a block and click **Add**
   !["Add generator type" menu ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4635a346d4c30f9c37b9adc635670b431cb5041_0.webp)
4. The generator type is now available immediately
   ![Generator making diamonds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3f2fd729cd6883db4b5fe8e1ac792038fc4a064.png)

## Requirements
- [Create: Cobblestone](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-cobblestone)
